goal: R review: data handling, package sources, file paths and reproducibility.
use: R review: data handling, package sources, file paths and reproducibility. Use when asked to review an R project or analysis.

steps.note: Read the project setup. The renv or package files and the R version.
Check data handling. Flag personal data written to shared files.
Check packages. Flag packages installed from unknown sources.
Check paths. Flag paths built from input.
Report. Each finding with file and line, severity and the fix.
